title: Supervised orthogonal abundance calibration from bulk expression
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: DeconvoBuddies DLPFC, 39 bulk samples/five donors/seven blocks train, 24 samples/three donors/four blocks test; 2000 training-variable logCPM columns. Predict unadjusted Circle-panel Astro/GFAP, EndoMural/CLDN5, Inhib/GAD1 fractions from adjacent-section IF/RNAScope. Equal-donor/equal-block RMSE; fractions need not sum to one. No snRNA reference supplied.

existing_reference.name: Training-donor-CV ridge with inner-training gene selection, scaling and donor/block weighting
existing_reference.strength: Appropriate regularized small-n, high-p supervised abundance baseline.
problems: Not a reference-only cellular deconvolution specialist.
39 measurements contain only seven distinct training blocks; bulk replicates repeat labels.
Anonymous numerical columns prevent gene-token or marker-reference methods without an amended interface.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: BisqueRNA / hspe with Mean Ratio markers
candidates.evidence: B: strongest directly relevant source orthogonal-validation evidence among evaluated deconvolution methods.
candidates.information_match: Requires acquired cell-reference matrix, gene mapping and normalization; original seven-cell-class endpoint and split differ from this three-output supervised slice.

candidates.name: DECONVersation with Geneformer / Cell2Sentence embeddings
candidates.evidence: C: current foundation-assisted deconvolution preprint, includes brain comparisons.
candidates.information_match: Needs gene identities and cell reference; not direct anonymous supervised calibration and not verified on held-out donor/block scorer.

candidates.name: BayesPrism / InstaPrism, MuSiC, CIBERSORTx
candidates.evidence: B: established reference-based contenders, with context-dependent source performance.
candidates.information_match: Need external cell reference and broader composition; computational speed or pseudobulk performance is insufficient.

candidates.name: Nested donor-CV PLS / elastic net / reduced-rank regression
candidates.evidence: C: proposed matched supervised alternative, not a published deconvolution win.
candidates.information_match: Uses the existing features and measured targets only; block-equal weights and all preprocessing inside training splits.

recommended_next_comparator: For unchanged K05, add donor/block-weighted PLS/elastic-net shrinkage. For a separate reference-deconvolution track, acquire a donor-independent snRNA reference and compare Bisque/hspe, fixed marker NNLS and DECONVersation under equal reference access.
switching_assessment: KEEP the supervised-deviation label and ridge reference. Do not present it as beating the best deconvolution model. Tier B supports Bisque/hspe for a new reference track, Tier C supports supervised challengers. No target substitution with prop_sn or renormalization is allowed.
limitations: Original IF/RNAScope prop, not algorithmic snRNA composition, remains target.
Adjacent sections and cell-size/RNA-content differences complicate reference-deconvolution calibration.
Three target fractions do not exhaust all detected nuclei and must not sum to one.
DECONVersation primary indexed extract was available but direct page returned 403; exact code availability unverified.
Original paper winner among six methods is not proof of current global best or a matched K05 result.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
